title: Let’s not forget
intro: Clothing, prayer times, the adhan and iqamah, the Qiblah and the niyyah.

learn.html: Let’s not forget! Say the missing words with your muallim:

items: The third condition of Salah is being properly ______. With clothes we protect our body and our ______.
Clothes for Salah should be clean, ______, comfortable and ______ – not see-through, dirty, ______ or with pictures.
The fourth condition is praying ______. There are five prayer times: ______, ______, ______, ______ and ______.
We cannot pray while the sun is ______, when it is in the ______ of the sky, and while it is ______.
The adhan announces the prayer ______ and calls us to pray ______.
In the iqamah we add: ______ – the prayer is beginning.
The fifth condition is facing the ______ – the direction of the ______ in Makkah.
The sixth condition is the ______ – deciding to pray.

questions.q: What do we add in the iqamah?

practice.title: Say it
prompts: 🗣️ Recite the adhan, the iqamah and the dua after the adhan!
